name: GSAP
summary: Framework-agnostic JavaScript animation library for CSS, SVG, canvas, WebGL and more.
description: A JavaScript animation library that animates CSS, SVG, canvas, React, Vue, WebGL, colors, strings, motion paths and generic objects with sequencing, easing and timeline control. ScrollTrigger covers scroll-driven animation, optional plugins add text splitting, morphing, motion paths and FLIP, and a @gsap/react package exposes the useGSAP() hook. Free for everyone, including commercial use and the bonus plugins.
contains: animates CSS, SVG, canvas, React, Vue, WebGL, colors, strings and motion paths
ScrollTrigger and ScrollSmoother for scroll-driven animation
plugins incl. SplitText, MorphSVG, motion paths, FLIP and Observer
free for everyone, including commercial use and the bonus plugins
